_comment: Single source of truth for MDO3D divination prices. Ladder (JARVIS MDO-S10 (a), decided 2026-10-14 under the Principal pricing delegation; supersedes #63 $5/$10): single reading $3 / three-card, three-rune, two-person or three-life reading $5 / full spread (Celtic Cross, five runes, full chart, full home, deep dive) $9. Shown price == charged price. Edit here, then run `node projects/divination/shared/sync-pricing.mjs` to copy each product slice into its api/src/pricing.json and frontend pricing.json. `--check` fails on drift. JARVIS #63b (2026-10-12): no monthly tiers.
